[[File:Databank_Squib_colored.jpg|thumb|right|150px|A [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] wearing a loincloth.]]
A '''loincloth''', also known as a '''breechcloth''',<ref name="Payback">{{StoryCite|story=Payback: The Tale of Dengar|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref> was a type of undergarment, worn by various species to cover the loins. Loincloths were also worn by certain servants and [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]] and [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], particularly those of the [[Chekkoo clan/Legends|Chekkoo clan]], were known to wear loincloths.<ref name="Rodia">{{WEGCite|story=A Brief Visit to Rodia|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref> The breechcloths worn by [[Aruzan/Legends|Aruzan]] citizens were usually [[Color/Legends|white]], and [[Platinum/Legends|platinum]] [[Necklace/Legends|necklaces]] were sometimes used as an accessory.<ref name="Payback" />
